questions.question: On this day in 1966, which Motown vocal group became the first all-female act to top the US Billboard 200 album chart?
questions.explanation: The Supremes reached the peak of the Billboard 200 with their ninth studio release, The Supremes A' Go-Go.
questions.context:
On this day in 1966: With their album The Supremes A' Go-Go, the Supremes became the first all-female group to reach number one on the Billboard 200 chart.
The Supremes A' Go-Go (Album by the Supremes): The Supremes A' Go-Go is the ninth studio album released by the Motown singing group the Supremes. It was the first album by an all-female group to reach number-one on the Billboard 200 album charts in the United States.

questions.question: Which Shakespearean comedy served as the basis for the 1999 teen romantic comedy 10 Things I Hate About You?
questions.explanation: Directed by Gil Junger and starring Julia Stiles and Heath Ledger, the 1999 film was an adaptation of William Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew.
questions.context: 10 Things I Hate About You (1999 film by Gil Junger): 10 Things I Hate About You is a 1999 American teen romantic comedy directed by Gil Junger from a screenplay by Karen McCullah Lutz and Kirsten Smith. Adapted from William Shakespeare's comedy The Taming of the Shrew, it stars Julia Stiles, Heath Ledger, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Larisa Oleynik, Larry Miller, Andrew Keegan, David Krumholtz, Susan May Pratt, and Gabrielle Union.

questions.question: The Apple TV+ spy thriller series Slow Horses, featuring MI5 rejects at Slough House, is based on the books of which novelist?
questions.explanation: The series was adapted for television by Will Smith from the Slough House series of novels by Mick Herron.
questions.context: Slow Horses (British spy thriller TV series (2022–present)): Slow Horses is a British spy thriller television series based on the Slough House novels by Mick Herron, and adapted for television by the English comedian and writer Will Smith. It follows Slough House, an MI5 unit where disgraced or failed agents are consigned, under the supervision of Jackson Lamb.

questions.question: Which former professional football star is a minority shareholder in the Italian Serie A club Como 1907 alongside manager Cesc Fàbregas?
questions.explanation: Former French international Thierry Henry and Como manager Cesc Fàbregas are both minority investors in the Italian side.
questions.context: Como 1907 (Association football club in Italy): Como 1907 is an Italian professional football club based in Como, Lombardy, that competes in Serie A, the top flight of the Italian football system. Founded in 1907 as Como Foot-Ball Club, the team traditionally plays in royal blue and has hosted home matches at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia since 1928. The club was acquired in 2019 by the Hartono brothers through Djarum Group. Minority shareholders in the club include head coach Cesc Fàbregas and former international footballer Thierry Henry.

questions.question: Before being bought out by Electronic Arts in 2007, which Canadian video game studio was founded by three newly qualified medical doctors in Edmonton?
questions.explanation: BioWare was established in Alberta in 1995 by medical graduates Ray Muzyka, Greg Zeschuk and Augustine Yip.
questions.context: BioWare (Canadian video game developer): BioWare was a Canadian video game developer based in Edmonton, Alberta. It was founded in 1995 by newly graduated medical doctors Ray Muzyka, Greg Zeschuk and Augustine Yip. The company was acquired by American publisher Electronic Arts in 2007.
